title: BotW Pickup
description: Adds the item pickup - GUI from The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild to Minecraft!
body:
## BotW Pickup Mod
Ever wondered exactly what you’re picking up in Minecraft? This mod brings a clean and modern item pickup display inspired by Zelda: Breath of the Wild!

### About
This mod adds a simple item pickup notification on the top right of your screen, similar to the advancement popup, but in a "modern Minecraft" - style. Whenever you pick up an item, it will slide in smoothly, showing the item icon and name clearly, making it easier to track loot, resources, and drops in your world.

### Why you need it
- Instant info: No more guessing which item just dropped in a pile of loot.  
- Modern look: Feels more polished and immersive, inspired by BotW’s elegant UI.  
- Better for inventory management: Helps you decide immediately if you want to keep or ignore items.  
- Fun and satisfying: The smooth slide-in animation adds a small but delightful visual reward for you and improves the game experience. 

Enhance your Minecraft experience with a UI that keeps you informed while staying stylish!
